description: Retrieve the feedback saved for a dropbox folder — score, graded state, feedback text, and rubric assessment detail. Students: omit entityType and entityId to read your OWN released feedback on an assignment (it is not hidden; use this when get_assignments shows feedback unavailable). Instructors and TAs: pass entityType and entityId to read what is already saved for any user or group, e.g. before drafting new feedback; reading another user's feedback requires instructor or TA access to the course.

courseId.description: Course ID the dropbox folder belongs to.

entityId.description: User ID or group ID whose existing feedback to retrieve. Omit to read the signed-in user's own feedback.

entityType.description: Whether entityId identifies an individual user or a group. Omit both entityType and entityId to read your own feedback.

name: get_dropbox_feedback
title: Get Dropbox Feedback
